Blue Ridge and Green Meadows Plan Community Carnival Tonight

October 8, 2026 Melissa Jacobs Local News Comments Off on Blue Ridge and Green Meadows Plan Community Carnival Tonight
Blue Ridge Primary School and Green Meadows Intermediate are inviting students, families and community members to an evening of fun at the upcoming Fall Carnival.
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:45
Instaread

The event is scheduled for Thursday, October 8, 2026, from 5 to 7 p.m. at Blue Ridge Primary School.

Families can enjoy an evening filled with games, prizes, inflatables, food and plenty of fun for all ages.

Organizers are encouraging families to mark their calendars and come together for an evening of community fun.
